content: {"like":["Fight scenes are pretty well done."],"dislike":["Strong aversion to the 1980s Hong Kong comedy style, which is silly and slapstick.","The hero is a dopey sap who engages in extreme risks on impulse, making the plot ridiculous.","Several strong sexual references that are distinctly adolescent and more annoying than funny or provocative.","The only nudity involves bare backsides of old men, which is also annoying though intended to be humorous.","The soundtrack was left in the original Cantonese, not translated into Mandarin or English."]}
